findings.title: V7 rejected valid containers without a Health map; the exact v8 correction is now measured
findings.rationale: Resolved for the exact v8 candidate, not an outstanding v8 blocker. Actual v7 invocation receipt 0422a7f7af4c54a26ab556368102e929ce2760e6671d5b4a0723dff3b7c66951 records native exit 1 in preflight_resources, before origin access or resource/tag mutation. Root's bounded reproduction attributes that failure to strict Docker template access of missing .State.Health on valid Web/gateway resources. The earlier API-only compatibility probe did not cover this heterogeneous boundary, and the prior review missed it. V8 uses a Go raw-string Health key through with index inside a PowerShell single-quoted literal; a missing optional map produces an empty health field while ID/image/state fields and the four-field shape remain required. The API's explicit healthy requirement and every identity/ownership guard remain unchanged. I verified the complete v7-to-v8 diff and read the retained source-bound AST replay: actual API/Web checks plus Assert-PreservedResources exercise all seven known containers and the five volumes. Its exit-0 stdout reports healthy API, empty Web/gateway health, preserved resources, exact API/Web/candidate tags and absent rollback tag. The new replay has its own source/receipt hashes and does not retrospectively attribute source provenance to the earlier ephemeral probe.
findings.suggested_action: A, selected and inspected: record Integrated against v8 SHA 01e198a7818b51fe447f46923f38b95d159e05aaeda4f3cdf27ae438f80b05b1, retaining the nil-safe formatter and the measured all-resource replay. Effort low; mutation blast unchanged; one accessor and a small targeted probe to maintain; no steady-state performance cost; simple structure without per-service exceptions. B: obtain a narrowly projected State JSON object and parse optional health explicitly; effort/maintenance higher, same read-only scope and mutation blast, modest serialization overhead, sound but unnecessary complexity here. C: retain the v7 formatter or validate only API; zero effort but a demonstrated preflight blocker on valid resources, incomplete operational confidence and no performance advantage. Preserve the failed v7 receipt and consumed authorization; do not reuse it for v8.

overall_assessment:
No unresolved material defect was established in the exact v8 candidate SHA 01e198a7818b51fe447f46923f38b95d159e05aaeda4f3cdf27ae438f80b05b1 after this bounded remediation review. The finding above records the observed v7 defect and its measured correction. Acceptance remains pre-activation and advisory. Neither the earlier review nor this result establishes that the policy is publicly served or that the complete live operation will succeed.

The original complete review/rubric remains in force, including all five cp64 critique resolutions, the four corrected final-review findings, the full frozen package and cp63 Composition/Residual Risks. Original raw 81aee5d1342852a4bda7f18afbbd63f3ff0fadadcf58c40d4eaf809a657ffe4d is unchanged. I read the complete v8 package; the full dispatch delta changes only the package path, bounded objective and absolute result binding, preserving the original axes and historical-disposition policy. Package SHA is 372ae74e49b17fc7fd3af241e75640e71b45b8e7cb249e8e37832539d297832c; dispatch SHA is 2ad299514d93e8215f8635d2fcc1b733fa0b6cac86f01363b90853751b45633f. This is continuation of the independent assurance review, with docker/nestjs/react/vite scope and the same security-adversarial lens; implementation remains owned by root/executor.

Actual failure takes precedence over historical candidate confidence. I read the full v7 failed activation receipt, preserved stage JSON and root stop adjudication. The receipt records exactly one invocation, exit 2, original native code 1, failure at preflight_resources, originWriteOutcome=not_started, no operation API/Web IDs, no tag/origin/recreation/reload action and no policy verification. The stage hash remains 9d7f04353d7d50c13bccc1bef75fe5dc872f28a944e6268084a48c836e23df26. This was a facts-accessor defect, not evidence that Web/gateway were unhealthy. The consumed v7 GO is not valid for another attempt or helper. No private rollback is needed for that failed attempt, and its incomplete-postcondition label is not promoted into a successful operation.

I independently verified equal source/review-copy hashes and their byte equality. The complete v7-to-v8 diff contains exactly two literal replacements: the nil-safe Health formatter and cp64-activation-stage-v8.json as the new receipt path. All other bytes, including the full previously reviewed lifecycle/transaction/diagnosis/rollback logic, are unchanged. The new path preserves the actual failed v7 stage evidence. The formatter is a direct optional-field correction: it does not swallow native errors, omit image/state/label validation, synthesize healthy status, or add service-name bypasses. PowerShell single-quote handling preserves the Go raw-string backticks, and the actual replay establishes that this exact native argument works in the declared environment.

Measured correction evidence: preparation SHA 891759bb0c3a6b5e8a073a427640c739d773faeba7d1384018d4cdfa9a8873d2 records parser/plan/predicate acceptance and no ApplyAll invocation. The original all-seven receipt 1e51128465a04448281f5f2d486c1b1261faa17d7a93366ffb56bacecde8ce92 remains immutable; its original command input was ephemeral and is not claimed as a retained source file. The new retained replay source facbe9f57e9df7ab2c9289208f094a96833654f0cfaeb37df03e649497534282 pins v8's hash, extracts only five allowlisted read-only functions and ten pinned public constants from the AST, and invokes the actual accessor/guards against the exact known resources. Replay receipt 5617fa5c644fd85073a8c285c889a712f33501c60ec7d30b070b9e4a636d527d records exit 0 and the actual safe stdout. The probe makes no Compose, private-file, Config.Env, provider, database or mutation call. This is meaningful coverage of the discovered boundary rather than a parser-only or API-only substitute. It does not claim a full helper execution or prove future private-write/recreation behavior.

Fresh supplied transport preflight f037211ada0bdc888dc62cf8d8dfef4fa9d6e8aa87b141b90d5e830c9ab220d0 binds v8 and the same native supervisor 14708/ticks 639278403605890201 and child 2148/ticks 639278403607622938, expected paths/hashes/argv/parent/config/target and addressing-mar-perform-hormone.trycloudflare.com. Windows and WSL normal-TLS/no-session/no-redirect root/health/JS observations pass with JS d14343604557296f2ed62c1df47d9c80d81c323abafd89ccbb64a6a0746ff4bd, no Set-Cookie, and equal managed gateway/template SHA 9329131376e0aaa8020e7440954af5125a65eb2bba69fd016292fe63843fe707. That receipt retains rootAccepted=false and operationAuthority=PENDING. These are executor observations I read, not runtime inspections performed by this reviewer. The one connection/one error event and ephemeral hostname still imply no lifetime/stability guarantee, and transport success is not policy acceptance.

Adherence, security and unchanged full operation: selected-service/image/tag/owner/project guards, exclusive byte CAS with same-handle interrupted-write recovery and ACL checks, target-only logical uniqueness parsing, public Compose interpolation pins, original-failure capture, logging-failure survival, ownership-constrained rollback and honest incomplete outcomes remain byte-identical to the reviewed v7 path. The admitted conditional gateway diagnosis still requires recorded topology/config/direct-route evidence and the relevant changed backend IP before at most one guarded same-container nginx test/graceful reload and a complete repeated public probe; no broad restart, gateway edit/recreate or speculative reload is introduced. Actual fresh identity/config/selection preconditions still belong to root before a new invocation. The v6 lost-binding qualification remains intact: overwritten ce989... predecessor bytes are not reconstructed or certified. No new private read, raw error/provider log, environment dump or credential handling is added by v8.

Test/evidence composition and rule spirit remain unchanged. The accepted static policy source/candidate, canonical Web build/28 tests, candidate HTTP/layout/runtime/JS evidence, source9 manifest and full TQA j/distinct final j remain scoped to their actual identities/dates and unchanged behavior. API fe5fb7 is not relabeled as j; no fresh all537/browser-j/served API-j or immutable historical Node-base proof is claimed. The optional-health correction needs targeted operational boundary evidence, which is now supplied; repeating product builds/tests or weakening their expectations would not verify this bug. I found no additional scoped P1/P2 defect, guard bypass, fake receipt/SQL state promotion, hidden runtime overlay or approval-scope expansion in the exact correction.

Performance is acceptable: formatting one optional field and changing a receipt filename add no steady-state workload or identified performance regression. Elegance is acceptable: one nil-safe accessor replaces an invalid assumption without container-specific patches or new dependencies. Structural soundness is acceptable: native errors and required health/identity checks remain enforced, and failure evidence is preserved separately. Operational fit is acceptable for a newly authorized pre-activation attempt, with improved measured heterogeneous-resource confidence. Full ApplyAll and post-activation behavior remain unmeasured; the live transaction and recovery risks from the original package are not waived by the replay.

All residual gates remain binding. Actual public policy 200/text-html/strict UTF-8/meta/exact 12,865-byte d0f72c588f0f014de46a327e34d6b26125ca115bc973b56bbb926cd8519e701d/no auth-cookie-redirect/CSP-referrer-noindex, root/health/JS and exact resource-preservation receipts are required before URL delivery or D11/VAL09/DOD09 acceptance. Parent ST-CON-01 remains Pending, official real IN/OUT/recovery VAL05 is open and unwaived, and panel synthetic 200/nonofficial cp49/cp52 observations do not substitute. R02/BLG-leadshug-runtime-dependency-security and the existing private OWNER/test-cohort restriction remain due before untrusted authenticated users. No dependency upgrade, additional cohort, Meta publication, production/Railway action, source push, gitlink action, domain/account acquisition, credential/provider change or data migration is authorized.

I performed only named public file reads and content-hash/byte comparisons and wrote this new delegated raw result. I ran no helper, parser, predicate, replay, product test, network request, process/Docker inspection, environment/private-file/cookie/provider-log access, Git operation, delegation, worktree or goal action. The original raw review and failed activation/stage artifacts remain unchanged.
recommended_path: Record CP64-FINAL-V8-01 as Integrated against exact v8 01e198a7818b51fe447f46923f38b95d159e05aaeda4f3cdf27ae438f80b05b1 and the source-bound readonly replay. Preserve v7, its consumed GO, failed raw/stage and original review, along with the earlier source-provenance qualifications. Root may adjudicate a fresh version-bound v8 GO for the already authorized operation after current transport/resource/image/tag/config/selection checks; do not reuse the v7 authorization. Use only v8's distinct stage receipt and the unchanged bounded origin/API/Web/recovery contract. Require actual complete public policy and regression/preservation proof before delivering a working URL or accepting D11/VAL09/DOD09. Stop honestly on new failure or incomplete restoration; the replay is not permission to bypass a guard or broaden recovery. Parent Pending/official VAL05 open and unwaived, private-cohort dependency debt and all publication/production/source boundaries remain unchanged.
